text: Training Objectives: To cultivate industry-leading talents who are well-rounded in morality, intelligence, physical fitness, aesthetics, and labor skills, possess innovative consciousness, teamwork spirit, and an international perspective, have the ability to integrate multiple disciplines, and systematically master knowledge and skills in fields such as biomass resources, energy, materials, and bio-based chemicals. They will be able to engage in teaching, research, and technological development in the field of biomass energy and materials. Main Courses: Inorganic and Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Physical Chemistry, Chemical Engineering Principles, High Molecular Chemistry and Materials Fundamentals, Basic Knowledge of Biomass Chemistry, Physics and Chemistry of Biomass Energy, Introduction to Biomass Science and Engineering (Bilingual), Biomass Chemical Engineering, Biomass Chemicals, Biomass-Based Functional Materials, Principles and Engineering of Biomass Energy.
